summary: Short north kerb beside bush and a school car park entrance; room to stop unclear.
reasons: Bush on one side, school car park beyond
Next to a side access road
Little visible verge to pull onto

drivers.seclusion: No homes in range; nearest building is a school block 58 m away, bush behind the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, but the north edge is tight against bush and a side access road joins near 10-17 m.
drivers.traffic: School-run traffic and a car park entrance next to the stretch; power lines on the south side.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the south kerb; none clearly parked on this north side; signed school loading zone.

flags: Low-lying: 14.5 m, Witton Creek 5 m away
sun_shade: Heavy canopy shade from the east and north; open to afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: East end of this stretch, beside the dense bush, before the school access road
